#!/usr/bin/env python3
import csv
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

# Read the service intensity data for stops
service_df = pd.read_csv(
    "outputs/t06_stop_service_intensity.csv",
    dtype={
        "stop_id": "int64",
        "stop_name": "str",
        "stop_lat": "float64",
        "stop_lon": "float64",
        "n_departures": "int64",
        "n_routes": "int64",
        "first_departure": "str",
        "last_departure": "str",
    },
)

# Read the POI nearest‑stop data
poi_df = pd.read_csv(
    "outputs/t09_poi_nearest_stop.csv",
    dtype={
        "qid": "str",
        "label": "str",
        "poi_type": "str",
        "nearest_stop_id": "int64",
        "nearest_stop_name": "str",
        "distance_m": "float64",
    },
)

# Join on the nearest stop id
merged = pd.merge(
    poi_df,
    service_df.rename(columns={"stop_id": "nearest_stop_id"}),
    on="nearest_stop_id",
    how="inner",
)

# Compute the auxiliary log values
merged["log_departures"] = np.log1p(merged["n_departures"])
merged["log_routes"] = np.log1p(merged["n_routes"])

# Maximum log values within the output rows
max_log_departures = merged["log_departures"].max()
max_log_routes = merged["log_routes"].max()

# Accessibility score as specified
distance_score = 0.5 * np.maximum(
    0,
    1 - np.minimum(merged["distance_m"], 1000) / 1000
)
departures_score = 0.35 * merged["log_departures"] / max_log_departures
routes_score = 0.15 * merged["log_routes"] / max_log_routes

merged["accessibility_score"] = distance_score + departures_score + routes_score

# Prepare final columns in the required order
output_columns = [
    "qid",
    "label",
    "poi_type",
    "distance_m",
    "n_departures",
    "n_routes",
    "accessibility_score",
]
final_df = merged[output_columns]

# Write RFC 4180 compliant CSV
final_df.to_csv(
    "outputs/t10_accessibility_scores.csv",
    index=False,
    quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL,
)
</solution_file>
